slides.label: In real life
slides.title: Three scenes
items:
How money was talked about at home
becomes how you handle it

Whoever can say “this is my rate”
without apologising earns more

Takeout and coffee runs decide
what’s left to save

slides.label: One system
slides.title: In and out
body: and what comes out of it
slides.closing:
A strong 2nd house: a voice people trust,
a steady saver

slides.label: Sutra
slides.quote:
What you say about money
becomes what you do with it

slides.label: Practical remedy
slides.title: One week
body: Catch every sentence you say about money

Swap one for a plain fact:
“I have $400 left this month”
Cook at home three nights; note what you saved
